scope: Qwen3.8-27B ONNX affine INT4/group32 on M1 Max 32 GiB; public GPU IOBinding experiments, not GenAI Engine
decision: Retain default rotary column gathers and K1. None of these followups established an end-to-end improvement. All experimental production changes were removed.

protocol.correctness: Every GPU request matched all 256 reference tokens. State, hidden arrays and dense logits remained GPU-owned.
protocol.limitations: Short-context followups are not 16K results. Screens have no warmups and are not qualification measurements. No newer Mac or CUDA execution was measured.

fixed_k2.implementation: KV-only self-conditioned second proposal; three-row target verification; exact one-/two-update FP32 state replay; speculative head KV is discarded and accepted drafts are re-fed with target hidden rows
fixed_k2.conclusion: Fewer target rounds and more accepted drafts did not offset the additional draft-head work.

confidence_gated_k2_screens.cpu_materialization: Sampled token IDs plus one confidence decision bit; no dense logits, hidden states or recurrent state
confidence_gated_k2_screens.conclusion: No compelling gain over bracketed K1; not promoted to default or claimed as a speedup.

last_logit_draft.implementation: Explicit draft graph companion slicing only the vocabulary projection input; all hidden-state and cache outputs unchanged
last_logit_draft.conclusion: Identical target tokens and speculative statistics, but no measured improvement.

native_padded_qmm_screen.implementation: Pad one-/two-row FP16 MatMulNBits activations to sixteen rows, use MLX native quantized matrix/split-K dispatch, and slice back; shapeless traces retain stock dispatch
native_padded_qmm_screen.conclusion: Gross screening regression; rejected without full qualification.

native_mlx_source.lesson: Stock MLX already chooses architecture-dependent vector/matrix thresholds and affine wide GEMV on supported newer GPU families. Do not force a losing M1 dispatch onto other Macs.

retained_16k_results.native_comparison_limitations: Native Q4_0 quantization, weights and generated tokens differ. MTP median matches the earlier native sample center; aggregate remains about 10% below it. All slow samples are retained in the original rotary qualification report.
